name: Kafka Studio
description: Operate Apache Kafka from one workspace: inspect topics and partitions, produce and consume messages, filter and decode payloads, monitor consumer lag, manage offsets and ACLs, stream records, and export results.
releaseNotes: 修复 DBX 隧道/代理下的 Kafka 连接：插件改为拨宿主下发的最终端点 runtime.host:port，并在宿主下发 runtime.proxy 时让所有 broker（含 advertised.listeners 发现的）共用同一个 SOCKS5 dialer，admin/生产/一次性消费/流式消费一致生效；代理路径补齐 TLS 握手与按 broker 的 SNI。消费组 offset 重置修复 Kafka 4.x 误报成功的问题（OffsetCommit v10 起以 topic id 标识主题，旧提交被 broker 以 UNKNOWN_TOPIC_ID 拒绝），任一分区被拒即返回错误。Fixes Kafka connections behind DBX transport/proxy layers: the sidecar now dials the host-provided runtime endpoint and, when the host publishes runtime.proxy, routes every broker (including brokers discovered via advertised.listeners) through one SOCKS5 dialer shared by admin, produce, one-shot consume and stream clients, with the TLS handshake and per-broker SNI applied after the proxy CONNECT. Consumer-group offset reset now commits by topic id for Kafka 4.x (OffsetCommit v10+) instead of being rejected as UNKNOWN_TOPIC_ID and misreported as success.
